title: The Latest Crier for Feb 26, 2026
items:
Late Night Central Art Event: Altered Books | Friday, Feb. 27 | 8-10pm | Maytag

Friday, February 27 | 8-10pm | Maytag Student Center 
All students are welcome to join us for this one-of-a-kind special Late Night Central event. Mary Robertson will guide us through an art project called Altered Books. This is a visual storytelling medium that allows you to explore and engage with the diverse world of arts and culture. Taking inspiration from underrepresented artists and influenced by graffiti and textured collages, we will have fun, create art, and tell stories by exploring the process of Altered Books.

Planning to stay in Pella this summer? Need a place to live?

Click here to find out more information about on-campus housing and fill out the summer student facility use contract. Space is limited so fill out the form and pay your first two weeks' rent by Wednesday, April 1st to reserve your spot. Contact Sarah Lunsford (lunsfords@central.edu) if you have any questions.

Gardeners needed!

The Central College Garden is seeking new gardeners for 2026! We are a small group of volunteers who grow fruits and vegetables and maintain the space at the Central College Garden on the corner of Peace and W. 3rd. We welcome anyone who wants space to grow their own crops and/or would like to collaborate and help out with garden maintenance. We are especially seeking a volunteer to help us manage the native flowering plants in the Monarch Waystation. If you don't have much gardening experience but want to learn, we'll pair you with an established gardener. If interested, please contact Mary Robertson or Valerie Billing.

STUDENT TRUSTEE SPOTS OPEN!

Student Trustee Applications are OPEN NOW and due March 6th at 5pm 
What is a Student Trustee? 

- A non-voting representative to the Board of Trustees and the voice for students during important decision-making processes 

How do I apply? 

- The application can be found in your Central email from ssenate@central.eduIt or at MyCentral > Student Life > Student Senate 

Who are the current Student Trustees? 

- Parker Lawrence, Madison Craig, Elyse Shaw, Cassie Elliott, and Mya Ehresman
